_comment: Allow-list for jk1 `checkLicense` — the swath dependency-license gate.
A distributed dependency PASSES if AT LEAST ONE of its declared licenses matches an
entry here (so dual-licensed deps like Jetty=Apache/EPL, Logback=EPL/LGPL, and the
Java-EE CDDL/GPL-with-Classpath-Exception bits all pass via their permissive option).
Entries are matched as regex against the NORMALIZED license name (see
license-normalizer-bundle.json). Bare GPL/LGPL/AGPL are deliberately NOT listed: a
future dependency that is GPL/AGPL-ONLY (no permissive alternative) will FAIL the build.
There are NO per-module exemptions, and none should be added: an exemption admits an
artifact precisely because its license could not be established, which is the one case
the gate exists to catch. If a dependency cannot pass on its declared license, exclude
Keep in sync with THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. See build.gradle.kts `licenseReport` block.
